title: Systems-Level Analysis of Membrane Trafficking: Challenging Pathway Independence Through AI-Driven Research

contributions.purpose: 通过文献综述指认膜运输研究的3个待验证核心假设
contributions.mechanism: 系统梳理35+篇文献(1960-2025),归纳"通路独立、蛋白复合物离散、疾病=单通路缺陷"三假设及三大知识缺口(时间协调/动态组装/系统级疾病)
contributions.evaluation: 无(文献综述,无原创数据)
contributions.domain: 细胞生物学 / 膜运输
contributions.source_quote: we identify three critical assumptions underlying current trafficking research: (1) pathways operate independently, (2) protein complexes function as discrete units, and (3) disease phenotypes reflect single pathway defects.

contributions.purpose: 提出AI驱动的三实验研究框架挑战上述假设
contributions.mechanism: 实验1多通路成像测通路串扰、实验2定量蛋白质组学测动态组装、实验3网络生物学测疾病多通路效应;配深度学习分割/GNN/贝叶斯建模
contributions.evaluation: 无(全为拟议实验+预期结果,未执行)
contributions.source_quote: We present a three-experiment research program using advanced imaging, proteomics, and network analysis to test pathway cross-talk, dynamic complex assembly, and multi-pathway disease effects.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This systems-level approach could transform trafficking research from reductionist pathway studies to integrated network biology

notes: desk-reject。提案/展望型论文,无实验(三实验框架全为拟议+预期结果)。非实证类适配:C2 evaluation 空,type 记 method(拟议)。数据/一致性红旗:(1)摘要称综述"35+ foundational papers",参考文献表实际仅14条;(2)假设含任意编造的阈值(H1.1 r²<0.1 vs H1.2 r²>0.3;H3.1<2通路 vs H3.2>4通路),缺依据;(3)3.3.2节文本破损/截断——"H2.1(Static): Complex composition remains constant (CV < 15"括号未闭合,疑PDF或生成缺陷;(4)参考文献 [Zanetti G, Nat Rev Mol Cell Biol. 2025;26(3):123-140] 及多条 bioRxiv 2025 未来/近未来日期,SNARE能量记作"35/1kBT"记法怪异,存疑。checklist AI披露高:设计=D、分析=D("AI conducted the majority")、写作=C、Hypothesis=B;AI Limitations 自陈"AI 被过多起始信息或弱证据干扰,实验建议常昂贵/劳力密集、成功率中等"。
